text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Sixteen racers are all vying to become number one in Japan today! The Grand Prix and final race of the year, the Arima Kinen, is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Oguriii! You've got it in you to be a two-time winner here! You're the greatest racer out there!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Creek! Now's your chance to make up for last year and show us what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: The final battle of the year is here, but who will be the winner? Oguri Cap or Super Creek? Or maybe someone else entirely! Everything hinges on this race!

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: We dream of seeing the best win, but we don't want to be stuck in mires of boredom and stalemates. You're the answer to combating such things, Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Reporter in Flat Cap
text_block_list.text: Show us what you're made of! Show us what this generation can do! And show us what the Twinkle Series is really about!

text_block_list.name: Townspeople
text_block_list.text: Gooo, Inariiii! You can do iiit!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Lay your soul on that track, Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hehe! This isn't the biggest race of the year for nothin'! You can really feel the heat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I've never been this nervous before… or this scared.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But that's why…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's why I gotta let my soul burn with all I've got!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: This anxiety 'n' fear are proof that this is the moment I've been waitin' for! I'm carrying all the hopes of everyone back home, so this is my festival!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'll show 'em all! I'm gonna let everyone see the true spirit of a festival—the soul behind their style!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on me, partner! I'll light up the sky above Nakayama with fireworks so bright, they'll write about 'em in the history books!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Right! See ya soon!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ Inari looks so determined.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Something good must've happened.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's really impressive. She looks like she's on fire.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I won't shy from that heat. I'll take it head-on.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (That's right! Clean your ears, everybody!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (Listen to the sky-piercing, earth-shaking music pouring from my heart! This is true music! This is the grand spirit of festival music!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Come one, come all! Gather 'round and listen close!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Born 'n' raised among the real locals, I'm an Umamusume with Oi flair! It's me, the Edo girl—Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hold on tight, 'cause the Arima Kinen's about to start! This is the battle that decides fates, the biggest festival in the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I stand here to challenge the best there is! Don't you dare blink or you'll miss my claim to victory!
